title: Where are my collections!?
body: This is the most confusing app I’ve ever used. Can’t find my collections. I don’t remember the exact name of each recipe so I can’t individually search for them. I’ve lost dozens and dozens of my favorite recipes. You really let us down!

title: Just use the web
body: The best way to describe this app is the way it does collections: I go to my “Saves” and it shows the first few categories, just like the web. I tap “Load more”, just like the web. The app then shows that I have no collections and no recipes. None. I reload. Same thing. I force close the app and reload. Same thing. So, between the lack of functionality in the app and the presence of an ad blocker in my browser, I’ll just use the web.

title: Ruined a Good Thing
body: Had an account on AllRecipes for years without any problems. Then MyRecipes comes along. At first I thought it was great, accessed other recipe sites, etc. Then along comes the MyRecipes app. Was difficult to navigate at first, but eventually figured it out. Until now. Cannot navigate what I can’t sign in to. Keep getting a File 403 message. App will not let me sign in. Cannot access Help tabs because the App will not open. I have around 500 recipes saved that I cannot access. This App is useless to me. I also cannot delete my account because I cannot access the App. Wish you had left well enough alone with AllRecipes. My Recipes is not getting it done. It appears I’m not the only one. If you reply to this don’t bother telling me to use the Help function. I can’t access the app to open anything up.

title: error code 403
body: I tried to use this app but I was never able to sign in, I kept getting error code 403. I researched support and the website and could not find error code 403. I just deleted it

title: MyRecipes App 2.0
body: If you’ve been around for more than a few years, you know that MyRecipes already HAD an app, and I, like many others, loved it, and paid for the “Lifetime Subscription”. Then, a couple of years ago, they took down the app and when we complained, they said, “Tough Luck, we aren’t doing an app anymore.” Now, lo and behold, they made a new app, but now there are only monthly and annual subscription options, so I guess it’s still, “Tough Luck. We already got your money and there’s nothing you can do about it.” Well, I’m not giving them another red cent, because they can’t be trusted to keep their agreements. Lifetime, my eye.

title: Can’t see the different companies articles or recipes
body: I though I would be able to browse Food and Wine recipes such as the articles posted on Facebook, or select search southern living recipes, but you can’t search by the different companies/collections so you can see the latest recipes by Food and Wine, etc.

title: Not free
body: You have to pay for this

title: Karen
body: Why is it APPS like these are ALWAYS SO DECEPTIVE? Free? NO ! Don’t fall for the gimmick people. Never is it FREE

title: Can’t go full screen on an iPad?!
body: Why do I want to try and read a recipe on only a third of my iPad screen? I’d much rather go to a website than try and use this on here. Can’t find and save all my favorites on the website anymore though so now I can only use this?! Make this available to fill in the entire IPad screen and we’d have a much better experience. I miss the Allrecipes dinner spinner app. That was so much better than this.

title: Don’t waste your time. Doesn’t work.
body: This app, MyRecipes, doesn’t work on my iPhone. It provides me a 403 error message with no further information. I had such high hopes to have all of the recipes in one spot that was easily accessible. Unfortunately this new app is not working out and will be deleted. It is a new app, so I will try again in a few months maybe if I remember to. Don’t waste your time.

title: All Recipes was just fine
body: Constant subscription pushing, no iPad optimization, lost all my favorites from All Recipes but uses the same recipe database. No thanks.

title: Can’t sign in
body: Downloaded app. Says I’m offline

title: My recipes
body: Very difficult to navigate.

title: What?
body: Download the 7-day free trial. On opening it announced the free trial ends TOMORROW. Trying to delete everything but it wants a subscription number. Where’s that? I feel swindled.

title: Doesn’t work
body: I signed in with my account I have had with them for years and it shows no saved recipes. Tried looking up some recipes and came up 0 results.

title: Bait & Switch
body: I am a 25+ year subscriber to BH&G print magazine, so I love the idea of saving their recipes in one place. But in the free version, every time I save a recipe, the screen locks up and gets all blurry. I have to close and reopen the app to access what I’ve saved or add another recipe. C’mon Meredith Publishing, I expect better of you.

title: Don’t bother
body: Awful cumbersome app. There are much better cooking apps. Expected better fro Food and Wine

title: What happened to the halves?
body: I find most recipes to Large so I use the 1/2 tool but now that I can’t find my recipes on the website I have to go to this app that doesn’t have the halves on it so I go to the app to find the recipes name and then I have to go back to the website and look it up. I’m really hoping that this is just a temporary thing and they fix this.

title: Not timely
body: Can’t even get into the app to link my existing account. If you’re going to require a code send the email in a timely manner or for that matter just send it. I tried three times today and only rec’d one code hours after requested.

title: Recipes are not good
body: I tried saving recipe from instagram 4 times but all didn’t work

title: It’s free until you try to import
body: I thought this was going to be great… I can’t afford to pay for it but I’m willing to deal with ads… but when I tried to save a recipe from social media I was shown the screen where it says importing… then it said the connection was interrupted… I tried 3 times… getting the same error… only there was no interruption… I never lost cell or WiFi… so is importing from social media only available if you pay?? I don’t recall seeing anything that stated that

title: money grab
body: i downloaded the app but it immediately wanted me to subscribe to get full features. it sounds like in 7 days the free trial turns into a paid subscription so i deleted it. i’ll use web page access like before. they also say they track a lot of personal data tied to your ID. i don’t need my info sold to more advertisers.

title: Needs ipad version
body: App not conducive to cooking, look to the NYTimes cooking app

title: Can’t use it!
body: I thought the app would be great. I signed up for the year, signed in, and then got to the page where you can opt out of tracking. Except it took up the whole screen, and I couldn’t do anything. Now it’s stuck there with no way to get past it. Very disappointing.

title: Total disappointment
body: I was so excited to see Allrecipes bring back an app. How terribly disappointing it is. It doesn’t size to an iPad. You have to pay or ads pop up. There is no view that shows the whole recipe so you have to scroll as you cook. You can’t print. Basically worthless. What a bummer.

title: Too much 🤦🏻‍♀️
body: It’s basically a place to hold recipes. Do we really need two factor authentication? Really? It’s annoying.

title: Features missing
body: Searching within the app for a saved recipe is useless. There are no guides for reducing or multiplying the number of servings. The web version is still better.

title: I Had High Hopes
body: When I saw that My Recipes was creating an app for saved recipes for the home cook, I was excited. Alas, not anymore. I downloaded it to my iPad and proceeded to try out the free version. (The full version is $39.99 and then there are in app purchases. Very pricey.) The app is very slow, it is clunky, and it has already frozen. I guess I’ll go back to printing out the recipes that look good and work on a paper index to sort and label them. Very disappointed.

title: Please Add Serving Size Adjustment
body: When using the website on my mobile browser, I don't have the option to see my saved recipes. This is the only reason I downloaded the app. I can access my saves here, but I can't adjust the serving size without going back to the browser and doing it there. So basically, I'm using both when everything could be in one place.

title: Reviews are hidden
body: You can’t read the reviews in the app. I found the user tips and suggestions often improved recipes significantly. You have to scroll down to “View Recipe on the Web” to take you to the full recipe details. If I have to do that why use the app in the first place? Consumer Reports did the same thing, making their app a summary of their product reviews, often leaving out critical decision making information. Hated that too.

title: No responsive development for tablets?
body: I pretty much exclusively use my iPad to display my recipes while cooking. Using my browser to view my saved recipes on allrecipes.com had always worked for me. Now I am forced to download this app and the developers couldn’t include responsive screen sizes for tablets? I’d love to use my whole screen instead of 1/3 of it. The app is easy to use so I give 3 stars but please please include a full wide screen version for tablets.

title: Problems logging in
body: This app frequently asks me to login and when i do it tells me that the sign in failed and that i need to reconnect to the internet and try again. Please fix this.

title: Mobile Web and App Not Syncing
body: For the most part, the experience is fine but when I try to save recipes within the app, the collection feature doesn’t appear to be synced to the web application account I created. So when I try to create a new collection in the app, it says that it already exists but the collection doesn’t show in my list of collections for me to select and save the recipe.

title: Freezes up
body: Every time I save a recipe the app locks and freezes up. I was excited about being able to store all the recipes I like or want to try but not happy with the aggravation of having to completely close it every time

title: Great except why can’t I see reviews???
body: I was so glad to see Allrecipes came back with an app again, and it is great, EXCEPT, you can see others reviews of the recipes - this is key to review before making a recipe. I always look at others feedback first.

title: Love the app but.
body: I love the app. I’m so excited it’s finally here I just wish it had iPad support and maybe Apple silicon support so I can use it on my Mac. I love the app and I’m considering a subscription.

title: My Recipes = wow! Free! Fun! So many recipes! So much possibilities!
body: Wow, wow wow! I am a young entrepreneur and I want to start a cookie business! MyRecipes has a bunch of way cool cookie, cupcake, and no bake recipes! Double cool! I love!!!!!!

title: Strong Start
body: I have been cooking with this for the last three weeks and I love it. I have been using recipes from brands like Food & Wine and Serious Eats for years. Now I can organize those recipes along with all of the stuff I have been saving from social (and never looking at again).

title: Great app
body: Love having these recipes handy but I really want a way to organize and edit my Categories. That would really do it.

title: Amazing recipes, robust app
body: The recipes in this app are great, and it has a very refined user experience. Would definitely recommend!

title: Social saving for the win
body: I’m thrilled to see social saving finally here! So excited to save my favorite recipes from social in one place

title: The best recipe app out there
body: Simply put, it’s the best recipe app I’ve tried, and I’ve been through a lot of them. The thing that really separates this from the pack is their catalog, it’s just so much deeper than everyone else’s. Now with the ability to save recipes from anywhere, it’s limitless. Highly recommend!

title: Love it
body: Great app for cooking, love the design super easy to use!

title: Sweet App!
body: I’ve enjoyed using the website, but excited to have an app where I can see the recipes without all the clutter and ads. So convenient!

title: It’s back!
body: Well kind of - I’m referring to the old AllRecipes “Dinner Spinner” app - why was it ever discontinued?? MyR app appears to be the successor and has some great features; I used my old AllRecipes email to register and it even remembers some of the old recipes from that app! I haven’t had a ton of time to explore the app but it seems solid. Ad intrusion is minimal, but I’m curious to see how that evolves over time. I will probably pay for a subscription, but the free version has a lot to offer so no hurry there.

title: Good!
body: Love this app! So easy to use and I’ve found so many delicious recipes. Definitely recommend! ❤️

title: Great!!
body: Amazing recipes and the ability to save social media recipes works great!!! No more going through saved posts on instagram, all the recipes I need will be right here.

title: Amazing!!
body: I love this app it’s really convenient when I don’t know what to make and I love that it lets you save your favorites!

title: Love love love this app
body: Love that I can keep all my recipes in one place, including the recipes I find on TikTok!!!

title: Love it!
body: I have been using my recipes.com for a while now and very excited to use the app. It is just like the web version just a bit easier to use and all my recipes I have saved are there when I signed into my account. Can’t wait to start using the social save function when I see a recipe on my socials.

title: A Game Changer for My Saved Recipes
body: This app is 5 stars! I love having all of my saved recipes in one place, plus access to more than 100,000 recipes. My favorite feature is the ability to save recipes directly from social media. I had so many recipes saved on Instagram and TikTok, but no easy way to organize them or find them again when I actually wanted to make something. Now I can save and organize everything in one place, which makes it so much easier to keep track of recipes I want to try. I absolutely love it!

title: Great search and recipe coverage
body: It’s been really easy to for multiple filters at once (high protein + one pan), and there seems to be recipes for everything I search for.

title: Love It
body: So glad MyRecipes is now an app! It’s super easy to navigate. I especially like building my own featured collections so I can organize everything exactly the way I want to. Looking forward to continue using when I do my weekly meal planning

title: Love this!
body: I really, really love having one place to save all my favorite recipes! The personalized recipe recommendations are especially great — they save me hours of digging through websites and on social to find new recipes to fill out my weekly meal plan. 10/10!

title: Sharing with Friends
body: I’ve used MyRecipes on their website from before and was so happy to see an app come through! Definitely has been a smooth experience so far and now I can move all my IG saves from bookmarks to one app. Even found some I meant to make last year 😅 Can’t wait to share the app with my friends and keep cooking and hosting!

title: Great app!
body: Great having all the recipes from many of the websites I go to in one place! Plus I can save recipes from other websites and the recipe videos my daughter sends me on Instagram

title: Love the social saving
body: All the amazing photos I find on instagram can now live in the same spot as my other saved recipes! Score!

title: Recipe Heaven
body: I love this app. It’s beautiful, easy to use, and I can finally save all my recipes in one place no matter where I find them. Exactly what I’ve been looking for.

title: So glad to have an app finally!
body: Love that I can use an app for organizing for cooking now and so excited to save recipes from Instagram

title: All my recipes in one place
body: I already had a MyRecipes account, so I love that all I had to do was log in to the app and all of my saved recipes and collections were right there. It will make cooking so much easier because I’m not bouncing between different screens trying to find ingredients and directions. I also love being able to save recipes I find on Instagram. They’re imported as easy-to-follow recipes that I can edit and add to my collections alongside everything else I’ve saved. So convenient!

title: Finally!
body: I’m so happy that MyRecipes finally has an app, I’ve been using it all day and it is super smooth and easy to use. I love that they added the ability to save from instagram and TikTok - finally I can save all those delicious recipes as well!

title: Excellent Interface
body: The social saving feature is especially helpful!

title: The social save feature is a game changer
body: Downloaded today after seeing the update. I love the app, I needed a place to save all my reels with recipes in one place. Was I impressed when it perfectly saved my Ukrainian recipe and it came out clean and readable? It’s an understatement. No more screenshots I never look at again. Really impressed for day one.

title: FINALLY a place to save all my social recipes
body: I hate having to remember which social app I saved a recipe to. Now I can FINALLY have them all in one place! The app is easy to navigate and saving from social is even easier. Plus, it creates a recipe card for saved recipe video, SO MUCH easier than trying to cook while following a video. Highly recommend.
